replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
The applications are not currently open. When they are open, the way to apply is to post a thread in this forum with your answers to the application questions, which are located here: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/91e44537d

It has not yet been decided when the applications will reopen.
